# CarAdvisor

> CarAdvisor is a free car research and comparison tool for US car buyers. We provide detailed specs, safety ratings, real Reddit owner opinions, side-by-side comparisons, and an AI-powered recommendation quiz.

## What we offer

- Detailed pages for every major car make and model with specs, pricing, safety ratings, and pros/cons
- Side-by-side comparison of any two cars
- AI quiz that recommends the best car based on budget, lifestyle, and needs
- Real Reddit discussions from r/cars, r/whatcarshouldibuy, and r/askcarsales surfaced per car
- Resale value and depreciation estimates
- Loan and affordability calculator

## Key pages

- https://caradvisorusa.com/search — Browse and filter all cars by brand, fuel type, body style, price
- https://caradvisorusa.com/compare — Compare two cars side by side
- https://caradvisorusa.com/quiz — AI car recommendation quiz
- https://caradvisorusa.com/calculator — Car loan and affordability calculator
- https://caradvisorusa.com/depreciation — Resale value estimator

## Car detail pages

Each car has a dedicated page at /cars/[id] with:
- Full specs (horsepower, MPG or range, 0-60, seating, cargo)
- Starting price and trim levels
- NHTSA and IIHS safety ratings
- Pros and cons
- Real Reddit owner opinions
- Similar car recommendations
